riddles.riddle: I have a head and a tail, but no body. What am I?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
What belongs to you, but other people use it far more often than you do?
What kind of room has no doors, no windows, and cannot be entered?
I am full of holes, yet I can hold water. What am I?
I can travel all around the world while staying stuck in one single corner. What am I?
I am so fragile that if you say my name, you break me. What am I?
The more of me you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
I have keys, but no locks. I have space, but no room. You can enter, but you can’t go outside. What am I?
I am always following you around and copying your every move, but you can never touch me or catch me. What am I?
What has a neck but no head?
What gets wetter and wetter the more it dries?
Which weighs more: a pound of feathers or a pound of bricks?
riddles.answer: Neither, they both weigh one pound

What has to be broken before you can use it?

What goes up but never comes down?
What can you break, even if you never pick it up or touch it?

I have lakes with no water, mountains with no stone, and cities with no buildings. What am I?
What can travel faster than the speed of light?
What has teeth, but cannot bite?
What has many legs, but cannot walk?
What has a thumb and four fingers, but is not alive?
What can you catch, but not throw?
What gets bigger the more you take away?
Where does today come before yesterday?
What has one horn and gives milk?
What goes up and down but doesn't move?
What has legs, but doesn't walk?
What runs all around a backyard, yet never moves?
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
If you drop me I’m sure to crack, but give me a smile and I’ll always smile back. What am I?
What has a spine, but no bones?

What comes down but never goes up?

riddles.answer: There are no stairs (it's a one-story house)

What begins with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
What kind of coat is best put on wet?

What ends everything?

What umbrella does a king use when it rains?
What runs, but has no legs?
What kind of band never plays music?

What goes up when rain comes down?

What asks no questions but requires many answers?
What has branches, but no fruit, trunk or leaves?
What can you hear, but not see or touch, even though you can control it?
What never asks questions, but is often answered?
What is born in the ocean and dies in a teapot?
What has words, but never speaks?
What flies without wings?
What goes around the world, but stays in a corner?

riddles.answer: Mount Everest (it just hadn't been discovered yet)

riddles.riddle: What is red and smells like blue paint?

riddles.answer: Heat, because you can easily catch a cold

What word in the dictionary is spelled incorrectly?

What comes at the end of everything?
What key can’t open any door?
riddles.answer: A donkey (or a monkey / turkey / piano key)
